sloka: प्रस्थाप्य सेनामथ सो ऽग्रतस्तदा गजेन्द्रवाजिप्रवरौघसङ्कुलाम् ।उपास मासं तु नरेन्द्रपार्श्वतस्त्वथ प्रयातो रघुवंशवर्धनः ।। ७.६४.१८ ।।
transliteration: prasthāpya senāmatha so 'gratastadā gajendravājipravaraughasaṅkulām ।upāsa māsaṁ tu narendrapārśvatastvatha prayāto raghuvaṁśavardhanaḥ ।। 7.64.18 ।।

translations.english: Having first sent forth his army, which was crowded with excellent elephants and horses, Shatrughna, the增ifier of the Raghu dynasty, then stayed by the king's side for a month before departing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 64 ।। Thus ends the sixty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: अतएव हे पुरुपशादूल ! तुम घीरज रखो ओर इस निकम्मी बुद्धि को त्यागो और तुम सन्तप्त न हो
